name: EXAMPLE — synthetic value chain and biomass factors (NOT REAL DATA)

source.title: Synthetic values authored to exercise Scope 3 categorisation and biogenic carbon separation. Not derived from any published dataset.

verification.method: None. Exists only so the calculation engine and its tests have Scope 3 and biogenic cases to work against.
verification.notes: Excluded from the build whenever CarbonRequireVerifiedCatalog is set, so it can never reach a published package.
